item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"running_requests","expression":"len(self.running)","rationale":"Captures per-request scheduling, allocation checks, cached output construction, and state updates."},{"name":"waiting_requests","expression":"len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting)","rationale":"Captures admission, prefix lookup, queue operations, and new-request output construction."},{"name":"waiting_prompt_blocks","expression":"sum((r.num_tokens + self.block_size - 1) // self.block_size for r in self.waiting)","rationale":"Approximates block-dependent prefix lookup, allocation, and block-ID materialization during admission."},{"name":"running_block_boundaries","expression":"sum((r.num_tokens_with_spec + self.block_size - 1) // self.block_size - (r.num_computed_tokens + self.block_size - 1) // self.block_size for r in self.running)","rationale":"Captures additional KV-block allocation when running requests cross block boundaries."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is primarily an affine combination of running and waiting request counts, with additional work proportional to waiting prompt blocks and new blocks required by running requests."}
